invariants.rationale: Parallelism should be a positive integer to enable partitioning and parallel execution.
The input data stream should not be null, as it is used immediately in the method.
The flatMapToPair function must be non-null, as it is invoked to transform data.
The reduce function must be non-null to correctly aggregate values by key.
Parallelism should not exceed the number of available processors for optimal resource usage, though exceeding may be possible, this expresses a practical invariant.
